morphology.pattern_note: 沿用输入的独立词项标记，不表示已确认它是马来语固有词根。作为人名通常写作 Joel；读音随姓名持有者及来源语言而异，暂无已核实的马来语音标。

senses.zh_definition: 乔尔：外来人名，通常用作男性名字；输入未提供足以确定具体人物或其他所指的语境。
senses.en_definition: Joel, a personal name usually given to males; the supplied token does not identify a particular bearer.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, lazimnya nama lelaki, yang ditulis Joel; individu yang dimaksudkan tidak dapat ditentukan daripada maklumat yang diberikan.
senses.nuances: 此处为专名解释，不能据此认定 joel 是已获 DBP 收录的马来语普通词，故不标为 official。马来文通常保留姓名的原有拼写，不把姓名的历史含义当作现代词义。以下搭配及例句用于示范姓名的语法位置，并非经语料统计确认的高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Joel belongs to a Hebrew naming tradition and is conventionally interpreted as 'Yahweh is God'. Biblical transmission helped carry the name across languages. This history explains the personal name, but it does not establish that the unidentified lowercase token in this packet denotes a biblical figure or constitutes a Malay common word. [Asbury Bible Commentary](https://classic.biblegateway.com/resources/asbury-bible-commentary/i-author-date-purpose)
